llm.note: Gemini called directly through Google's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). Google does not report cost, so it is estimated from price_usd_per_mtok (list price, thinking counted as output); calls on the free tier actually cost $0.

worker_agent.note: The worker's search turns (choosing the next tool call) use this cheaper model; write_cases and the other nodes use the main model (ADR D23). Price from third-party listings, 2026-11-11.
